% The same source as after.tex, built with pdflatex instead of lualatex (see
% fixture.conf). This is the defect: ltx-talk falls back to sansmathfonts, whose
% OML-encoded sans maths has wrong ToUnicode maps, so the text layer is corrupt
% and no MathML is emitted at all.
%
% assert-naive.sh asserts the corruption. If it ever fails, ltx-talk has given
% the pdfTeX path a font with correct ToUnicode maps (or dropped the fallback) --
% the entry's "revisit when" -- and the runner reports it as advisory.
\DocumentMetadata{lang=en, pdfversion=2.0, pdfstandard={a-4,ua-2}, tagging=on}
\documentclass{ltx-talk}
\begin{document}
\begin{frame}

Inline: $g(a, b, c)$ and $x.y$ and $p \ldots q$.
\[ f(x) = \sum_{i=1}^{n} a_i x^i \]
\end{frame}
\end{document}
